answer: Marble-weighted reputation Each agent begins with a single marble representing initial trust. To create a new agent, one must fracture a walnut into two unequal pieces; only the larger piece may seed a new identity. The smaller fragment is permanently surrendered to the system. This act consumes physical entropy—each walnut has unique grain patterns, making replication impossible without destroying the original. The trellis structure enforces this by validating that each new agent’s origin trace links back to a distinct walnut.
